name: Wide arm pullup
description: A wide arm pullup is a pullup with the hands wider than the shoulders. Hang from the bar, pull up until the chin is over the bar, then lower back down.

items.content: Core braced, glutes squeezed, legs together

stages.name: Eccentric
stages.description: Dead hang from the bar with a wide grip, arms straight, body straight.

stages.name: Concentric
stages.description: Chin over the bar with a wide grip, elbows out to the sides, body straight.
